purpose.domain_detail: RPS Inc. ADS (Automated Distribution System) supplemental package diagnostics - barcode lookup for supplemental packages, likely shipping/logistics or retail distribution
purpose.summary: This program is a subprogram library providing barcode-based lookup routines for supplemental package diagnostics. It opens an indexed file (ADSPF015) keyed on barcode, and exposes multiple entry points (disklookup, closeallfiles, reopenfiles) to allow callers to look up package records by 34-digit barcode and retrieve PO number, invoice number, customer reference, department number, and download date. Error logging is written to a sequential log file.

notable_features: CRT STATUS / console is crt (GnuCOBOL screen handling)
Indexed file with dynamic access and manual locking
34-digit barcode support (noted in change log EPIC 12/15/11)
STRING statement for error message construction
ACCEPT from DATE YYYYMMDD and TIME
Line sequential file for error logging
verdict.notes: Program is clearly production code from RPS Inc., written for a Linux/Unix GnuCOBOL environment. The OASIS path in the COPY statement and COMP-X suggest GnuCOBOL. Change history references a 2011 EPIC change for 34-digit barcodes. No SQL or CICS. Fixed format confirmed by zero lines over 72 chars.
